slides.text: BolBot - WhatsApp AI Sales Assistant for Indian SMEs
Problem: SMEs lose 65% of potential inbound customers on WhatsApp due to slow replies.
Market: Indian SME conversational commerce market is ₹500 crore and rapidly growing.
Product: Automated multilingual catalogue, cart management, UPI payment links inside WhatsApp.
Competition: No direct competitors offering end-to-end WhatsApp conversational checkout.
Traction: 150 live SME merchants, 40 new merchants added per month, 10% MoM growth.
Unit Economics: ARPU ₹3,000/mo, CAC ₹4,500, Gross Margin 75%, Churn 4%/mo.
Team: Ex-Flipkart product lead and IIT Bombay ML researcher.
The Ask: ₹2.0 Crore at ₹10 Crore valuation for 18 months runway (₹8 Lakh fixed monthly burn).
